SELECT seq_product_img.nextval FROM dual
INSERT INTO product_img ( product_img_no, product_no, image_url, image_type, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{productImgNo}, #{productNo}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageType}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT product_img_no AS productImgNo, product_no AS productNo, image_url AS imageUrl, image_type AS imageType, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM product_img WHERE product_no = #{productNo} AND image_type IN ('THUMB', 'MAIN', 'GALLERY', 'SIZE') ORDER BY CASE image_type WHEN 'THUMB' THEN 1 WHEN 'MAIN' THEN 2 WHEN 'GALLERY' THEN 3 WHEN 'SIZE' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, sort_order ASC
